name: License Applications
description:
This dataset contains 5,000 sampled records of business license applications, with 35 fields covering the application, the business, the license, and the location involved. Each row represents one application, identified by an application_id, and includes the license number, business name, optional trade name (DBA), a business unique ID, and the business category (44 categories such as Tow Truck Driver, Home Improvement Contractor, General Vendor, and Tobacco Retail Dealer). Application details include whether the request is a New application or a Renewal, whether the license is for Premises or an Individual, the intake channel (Online or Walk-In), submission date, date closed, and current status (mostly Approved, with smaller shares Closed, Denied, Additional Info Requested, and Submitted). A small number of records include temporary operating letter issue and expiration dates.

Contact and location fields include phone number, address type, building number, street, unit, city, state, and ZIP, along with NYC-specific geography
